parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Default value: current time.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: The number of records per query for paged queries. Default value: 1000.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description: Metric name. Not filled. Not in use.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace for cloud service monitoring data. For more information about namespaces, see cloud service monitoring metrics.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination cursor token. If you do not set this parameter, the first page of data is returned. When a NextToken value is returned, more data is available. Use the returned NextToken as a parameter in your next request to retrieve the next page. Repeat until NextToken returns null, which means all data has been retrieved.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The statistical period for monitoring data. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 15, 60, 900, and 3600.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the monitoring data query interval (UTC). Default value: one hour ago.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: A temporary token used for authentication.
